FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS 1.1 The group reported a 16% increase in gross profit the in six months period ending 30th June 2019 compared to 2018 from Ksh 37 million to KSh 43 million. There was also a 31.6% reduction in loss for the period ending June 30th 2019 compared to 2018 from Ksh 138 million to Ksh 95 million. The group has reported a lower after tax loss of Shs 77million in the half year 2019 compared to a loss of 112 million in 2018, a decrease of 31.2% 1.2 Migaa Golf Estate, being a long-term project, is expected to realize its profitability towards the end of the project in 3 – 4 years’ time. In line with our accounting policy, proceeds of the project are carried as current liabilities in the balance sheet as deferred income and as deposits from sales of plots lingering at Ksh 2.8billion as at June 30th 2019 compared with Ksh 2.6 billion for the same period in 2018. This amount will convert to revenues in our statement of profit or loss as the percentage of completion of the project improves over the next 3 – 4 years. All expenses are usually expensed in the current period. 1.3 The book value of the group’s sellable land and other inventory stood at Sh3.7 billion in 2019. We continue to investment in the infrastructure of the various projects which will help improve the market value of the land bank as the land becomes more desirable. The directors do not recommend a dividend for the period ending 30th June 2019. The unaudited financial statements of the company were approved by the Board of Directors and signed on its behalf by: Dan Awendo Managing Director
